alt: Hand-drawn brain receptor diagram by Dr. Paul Johnson (DO) at Bartz-Altadonna Community Health Center, July 29, 2026.
full_text: A hand-drawn sketch on examination table paper depicting two face-like circles representing brain cells or receptors with arrows, the letter mu (μ) representing mu-opioid receptors, 'alpha-2' (α-2) representing alpha-2 adrenergic receptors, and 'k' representing kappa-opioid receptors, with an arrow pointing to a circled letter 'A' representing addiction or agonist actions.
summary: Condescending hand-drawn diagram made by Dr. Paul Johnson (DO) during a consultation at Bartz-Altadonna Community Health Center on July 29, 2026, attempting to simplify receptor kinetics while refusing clinical stabilization for benzodiazepine withdrawal.
